name: Cooperative Disabling [Teamwork]
body:
You are skilled at working with an ally to disable traps.

Prerequisite(s): Disable Device 1 rank, trapfinding class feature.

Benefit(s): When an adjacent ally uses the Disable Device skill and fails the check against a trap and you are within reach of the trap you can attempt a Disable Device check against the same device as an immediate action. You must have remained adjacent throughout the process of disabling the device and must have either aided at the Disable Device check or taken no other action. If you succeed at the check, the attempt is considered to be successful. If you fail, the attempt is considered to have failed by 5 or more, even if the original check failed by 4 or less.
